open.finding: The original filed card gives cap rise 0.374346974907 m but keeps full-sphere lift. All three closures spend the original 4889.44215019 kg. No sag-volume integral or lift deduction appears.
open.proposed_next: Integrate a boundary-compatible inward pillow, reduce displaced volume/lift, then re-run the mass-constrained scan in the separately assigned amendment. Cap rise alone does not uniquely determine volume.

open.finding: The lightest Zylon row is 109.701010474 kg of ideal two-direction fibre only. Resin, barrier substrate/coating, attachments and installation losses are unbooked. No complete gas-tight film system mass is supplied. Fibre alone exceeds the 97.515 kg pin.
open.proposed_next: Retain a structural lower bound and separately book the full assembly before claiming a lightest system.

open.finding: The scan has 50 kg for all systems. The inherited pump alone is 150-400 kg, not debited from tube mass. Reallocating all 50 kg leaves 100-350 kg unbooked; keeping the original systems adds the full pump. No getter capacity is sourced.
open.proposed_next: Book a selected pumping system, power supply and operating internal-pressure allowance, then re-optimize. The inherited class is not a new product qualification.

open.finding: Curvature equals bay side to preserve the 011b film equation. Circumscribed circular-cap rise does not establish compatibility with all three actual edge arcs. Film masses and gas rates use 4*pi*R^2 without pillow-area correction. Triangular tributary and scored arc line loads differ; the stated 011b load path is retained.
open.proposed_next: Specify boundary, shape, true area and load transfer consistently with the sag amendment.

open.finding: Half-ultimate Kapton/PEN/Vectran values are assumptions, not creep-rupture allowables. Kapton design gauge 843 um exceeds opened 12.7-125 um rows; PEN 927 um exceeds the 250 um strength row and transfers 25 um modulus/permeability. Kapton 115.5 MPa exceeds its 69 MPa stress at 3% yield and 90 MPa at 5% strain. Long-term shape is unqualified.
open.proposed_next: Retain gauge and sustained-load transfer assumptions; qualify the fabricated membrane and joints.

open.finding: Toyobo 19 years at 60% break is extrapolated HM filament performance. DSM 15/250 years at 20% break is an indicative 16 C rope comparison. Neither qualifies a resin-free 0/90 pressure membrane, joints or weather exposure. Toyobo calls for light protection outdoors.
open.proposed_next: Tag proposed membranes PROJECTION, while retaining sourced fibre inputs as QUESTIONABLE.

open.finding: N2 is available only for Kapton. Water retains source conditions, with no hull RH. Seams, defects, outgassing, thickness scaling and stressed/coated permeability are unqualified. Kapton source-condition sum is below the inherited allowance; it is not a complete service leak test.
open.proposed_next: Keep source and service rates distinct and close all gas paths before selecting the vacuum system.

open.finding: ALD bound is a supported lab coupon, not a bare film, fibre coating or hull-scale result; substrate and fabrication mass remain necessary. CNT/graphene production allowables remain uncomputed.
open.proposed_next: Retain coupon bounds and absent allowables; do not use them to close hull mass.
